LEAD DECISION: Node (its base class) is QUARANTINED in this slice. LiteralNode.m only calls the Node constructor (obj@Node()) and, via AndNode/OrNode, Node.addChild; the Node defects are confined to the methods removeDuplicateLiterals and isequal, which LiteralNode never calls, so under the call-form rule of III-Defects it does not reach them and was tested. If the lead treats the whole class as blocked, replace the body with the quarantine layout. Numeric IDs: LiteralNode(3).toString() gives 'x()' (char(3)) and contains(3) is false; the Node interface describes IDs as text, so not a defect (the numeric-ID limitation is already recorded in testAndNode).

notes: Quarantine layout; all 109 executable lines exempt. Minimal repro (MATLAB, after initCobraToolbox): n = OrNode(); n.children = [LiteralNode('1'), AndNode(), LiteralNode('2')]; n.removeDuplicateLiterals(); disp(n.toString())  % prints (x(1) or ) ; a = OrNode(); a.children = [LiteralNode('1'), LiteralNode('2')]; b = OrNode(); b.children = [LiteralNode('1'), LiteralNode('2'), LiteralNode('1')]; disp([a.isequal(b), b.isequal(a)])  % prints 0 1. Callers reaching the defects: removeDuplicateLiterals is called only by combineChildren.m:64 (via OrNode.convertToCNF) on an OrNode clause after reduce(), whose children are literals in CNF use, so the defective form (non-literal child among literals) is not reached there; Node.isequal has no caller in src/. Other Node methods (constructor, copy, addChild, getLiterals, ...) are not defective, so AndNode/OrNode/LiteralNode/GPRparser/removeGenesFromModel do not reach the defects by the call-form rule; lead to confirm. Lines 277-282 (getFunctionalGeneSets LiteralNode branch) are dead code (convertToDNF/CNF never return a LiteralNode), relevant when the quarantine is lifted.
